business_domain: Pharmacy benefits — medicine coverage and formulary lookup

tests.name: Generic drug (atorvastatin calcium) is shown as on the drug list with correct tier and dosage
tests.description: Verifies that a guest member searching for the generic drug atorvastatin calcium under the BCBS Alabama plan and SourceRx 1.0 Drug Guide sees correct dosage/quantity information and is told the drug is on the plan's drug list at Tier 1/Preferred Generic, both on the search results card and on the detailed medicine page.

preconditions.description: The user has entered the site as a guest, selected the BCBS Alabama health plan, and applied the SourceRx 1.0 Drug Guide drug list on the Find Medicines page.

evidence.quote: Drives the non-signed-in entry flow: home -> ... -> pick the configured health plan -> land on Find medicines with the configured drug list applied.

steps.description: Enter MyPrime as a guest (without signing in), select the BCBS Alabama health plan, and apply the SourceRx 1.0 Drug Guide drug list, landing on the Find Medicines page.

evidence.quote: Every test starts from here.

steps.description: Search for 'atorvastatin', select the matching autocomplete suggestion, and specify the drug's strength, quantity, and frequency to add it to the results.

evidence.quote: Full "add a medicine" flow in one call: search, pick suggestion, set strength/quantity/frequency, submit.

steps.description: Open the detailed medicine page for atorvastatin calcium to review its dosage and drug-list status in more depth.

evidence.quote: card.findElement(By.cssSelector("a.medicine-name")).click();

assertions.description: The dosage and quantity summary on the search-result card for atorvastatin calcium matches the expected 20mg tablet / 30 tablets over 30 days regimen.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member could see incorrect dosage or quantity information for this generic drug, leading to confusion about how much medication they will receive.

evidence.quote: Dose info on the result card did not match expected dosage/quantity

assertions.description: The result card correctly labels atorvastatin calcium as On drug list, Tier 1/Preferred Generic.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member would be shown the wrong drug-list/tier status for this generic, potentially causing them to believe it is not covered or costs more than it does.

evidence.quote: Formulary status on the result card did not match expected value

assertions.description: The medicine details page identifies the drug as atorvastatin calcium, confirming the correct medicine was opened.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member could land on details for the wrong drug, undermining confidence in search accuracy.

evidence.quote: Assert.assertEquals(detailsPage.getDrugName(), expected.getExpectedName());

assertions.description: The medicine details page shows the same expected dosage/quantity information as the result card for atorvastatin calcium.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member reviewing the detail page could be misled about the correct dosage or quantity for this drug.

evidence.quote: Assert.assertEquals(detailsPage.getDoseInfo(), expected.getExpectedDoseInfo());

assertions.description: The details page's formulary heading confirms this generic drug is 'On drug list'.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member could be incorrectly told this covered generic drug is not on their drug list, causing them to avoid a lower-cost option or seek an unnecessary formulary exception.

evidence.quote: Expected this generic to be marked \"On drug list\" on the details page

assertions.description: The details page's tier heading confirms atorvastatin calcium is classified as Tier 1/Preferred Generic.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member could be shown the wrong cost tier for this generic, leading to incorrect expectations about their out-of-pocket cost.

evidence.quote: Assert.assertEquals(detailsPage.getTierHeading(), expected.getDetailTierHeading());

assertions.description: Sanity-checks that the oracle test data itself flags atorvastatin calcium as being on the drug list, guarding against a stale or corrupted expected-data file skewing the test's meaning.
assertions.failure_meaning: If this sanity check fails, the oracle data itself is inconsistent, meaning the other assertions in this test cannot be trusted regardless of what the site displays.

evidence.quote: Test data sanity check: this drug should be flagged onDrugList=true

test_data.description: Oracle data captured from the live site describing the expected search, dosage, and formulary/tier outcome for the generic drug atorvastatin calcium under the BCBS Alabama / SourceRx 1.0 Drug Guide plan.
The health plan (BCBS Alabama) selected during the guest entry flow.
The drug list/formulary (SourceRx 1.0 Drug Guide) applied on the Find Medicines page.

tests.name: Selected health plan is reflected on the Find Medicines page
tests.description: Verifies that the health plan a guest chooses during the pre-login plan-selection modal (BCBS Alabama) is correctly displayed back to them on the Find Medicines page, confirming the plan context used for all subsequent drug-coverage lookups is the one the member actually selected.

preconditions.description: The user has entered the site as a guest and selected the BCBS Alabama health plan in the pre-login plan-selection modal.

evidence.quote: home -> "explore MyPrime without signing in" -> pick the configured health plan -> land on Find medicines

steps.description: Enter MyPrime as a guest (without signing in), select the BCBS Alabama health plan, and apply the SourceRx 1.0 Drug Guide drug list, landing on the Find Medicines page.

evidence.quote: Every test starts from here.

assertions.description: The 'Your health plan' banner on the Find Medicines page shows the same health plan (BCBS Alabama) that was chosen during the guest plan-selection flow.
assertions.failure_meaning: A member could see the wrong health plan reflected on the Find Medicines page, causing them to view drug coverage and formulary information for a plan that is not theirs.

evidence.quote: Find medicines page did not show the health plan selected during the guest flow

test_data.description: The health plan (BCBS Alabama) expected to be displayed back to the member after selection.
